text: くちからだす　はかいこうせんは　すべてのものを　やきつくす。

structure.jp: くちからだす　はかいこうせんは
structure.en: the Hyper Beam it fires from its mouth

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: くちからだす　はかいこうせん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. くちからだす　はかいこうせん = 'the Hyper Beam it shoots out of its mouth'.

patterns.name: 〜つくす
patterns.explanation: つくす joined to a verb means doing it until nothing is left. やきつくす = 'burns it all to nothing'.
